final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) as avg_spent, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) as mean_remaining FROM event_averages) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - overall_mean.mean_remaining as difference FROM event_averages, overall_mean ORDER BY CASE WHEN (avg_remaining - overall_mean.mean_remaining) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, (avg_remaining - overall_mean.mean_remaining) DESC LIMIT 10
